## Welcome to the OSI4IOT platform

Your organization's home dashboard could not be shown to your user.

This usually means that **your user is not a member of this organization** (or of the group whose folder holds its home dashboard), so it has no permission to see it.

- If you belong to several organizations, switch to yours with the organization selector (your profile menu, top right).
- Otherwise, ask the platform or organization administrator to add your user to the organization and to its groups.

Once you are a member, your organization's home dashboard and the dashboards of your groups appear here.
